aiExplanation: The code finds the maximum number of non-overlapping substrings where each substring must contain all occurrences of at least one character. It works by: first identifying the **leftmost and rightmost positions** of each letter (a-z) in the string, then **expanding each segment** to ensure it encompasses all occurrences of every letter within its current bounds, and finally **sorting segments by ending position** and greedily selecting non-overlapping ones using an interval selection algorithm, keeping only substrings whose starting position is after the previously selected substring's end.
